rows.en:
Maybe the kitten had been hungry; it started eating ravenously.
From then on, she went to see the cat every day, at lunch and after school.
Once she was keeping the cat in the lodge, she started looking forward to going to school.
The cat became her reason for living.
But one day, one of the bullies found out.{p}
When they heard about the cat, what do you think they did?
They dumped the cat somewhere
They killed the cat
They confronted Takeda about it
Yes, they dumped it somewhere.{p}

When Takeda went to the lodge as usual, the kitten wasn't there.
"The cat's gone..."
She searched for it.
She searched every corner of the school.
But she couldn't find the kitten.{p}

A few days later, she found the kitten walking along her way home.
"Where have you been? I was so worried about you.
Let's go back to school, okay?"
She took the kitten to school again.{p}

But on the way, the girls who had dumped the kitten caught her.
"So you found it, Naoko."
"Y-you were the ones who dumped it!"
"Yeah, we did.
But it's your own fault for keeping a cat at school, isn't it?"
"B-but..."
"If you don't want it dumped again, you'd better quit keeping it at school."
"Heh, heh heh heh."
They walked off, laughing.{p}

"What do I do...?"
Takeda crouched down right where she stood.
The next day, she stayed home from school.
And the day after that, and the day after that, she stayed home again.{p}

Even the girls who had been bullying Takeda started to get worried.
"All this over a stupid cat..."
By telling themselves that, they tried to forget about it.
But they should have realized.
Takeda had been driven so far into a corner that she couldn't go on living without the cat to hold on to.
It was a while after that.{p}
"Everyone, I'm sorry to have to tell you this, but Takeda has run away from home and gone missing.

If any of you have any idea where she might be, or if you've seen her, please come and tell me, anytime at all.
I'm asking you, please."{p}
Their homeroom teacher had announced that Takeda had run away from home.{p}

At break, the bullies gathered behind the school building.
"This is bad..."
"What do we do if they find out it's because of us?"
"Relax, they won't find out."
In the end, they decided to keep quiet.{p}

That day, maybe because they felt uneasy, they walked home together.
"Let's find her before anyone else does and threaten her.
Then nobody will find out it was our fault."
"I guess. But where could she be?"
"Maybe she went back to the lodge above the auditorium."
"Oh, right, it has to be there.
If she was going to go anywhere at all."{p}

They headed for the auditorium.
And when they opened the door to the lodge...{p}

"N-Naoko..."
Takeda was sitting on one of the beds.
"Why the hell did you run away from home?
You're getting us into all kinds of trouble."
"Yeah, hurry up and go home already."
Saying that, they laid into her and shoved her around.
Just then, they heard a cat.{p}

When they looked that way, a kitten was standing there, giving off a terrifying aura.
Then there were two, then three, and their numbers kept growing.
"What's with these cats?"
"Wasn't she only keeping one?!"
They backed away.{p}

Then Takeda spoke.
"After I ran away, while I was wandering around, I found kittens dumped all over the place.
I felt so sorry for them that I brought them all here, so I could take care of them."
Little by little, Takeda came closer to them.
"Aren't they cute?"
They were cornered and could no longer think straight.{p}

"Naoko, do something about those cats!"
"Yeah, there's no way you can keep them at school!"
Saying that, they kept laying into Takeda.
It happened just as one of them tried to grab Takeda's clothes.{p}
The kittens all attacked her at once.

The girls who were left screamed.
They tried to run, but their legs were frozen with fear and they couldn't move from the spot.{p}
While they stood there paralyzed, the cats closed in around them.{p}

The next day, there was a search for the missing girls.
Witnesses said the girls had gone toward the lodge, and when people went looking there, they found bodies that looked as if animals had torn them apart and fed on them.
Officially, it was put down to wild dogs, but nothing about it added up.
Even now, students who stay there say they woke up in the morning with cat scratches, or heard cats crying.
When I was at training camp, I woke up in the morning and found cat scratches on me, so I quit the soccer team that same day.
I was convinced the rumors were true.
Hm? Takeda, you mean?
She graduated last year.
The story I just told you is only a rumor, after all.
But they say Takeda still comes to the lodge from time to time.
And that the cries of cats echo through the school at night.
Maybe someone else has become cat food again.
That's the end of my story.
Next, please.{p}

Yes, they killed it.
Girls can be so cruel at times like this, can't they?{p}

And she killed herself, right there on the spot.
Takeda had been driven so far into a corner that the cat was the last thing she had left to lean on.{p}

The bullies panicked.
"This is bad. She actually killed herself!"
"Killing herself just because we killed a cat..."
"What do we do, you guys?"
"If we keep quiet, nobody'll know.
They said there wasn't a suicide note."
"Right. All we did was kill a cat."
They decided to keep their mouths shut.{p}

Several months passed.
In the end, Takeda's death was written off as a suicide brought on by a nervous breakdown.
And for those girls, the incident was already becoming a distant memory.
So when someone suggested the whole class hold a training camp over summer vacation to get ready for the ball-games tournament, the bullies agreed without a second thought.{p}

Everyone felt like they were on a little trip.
During the day they practiced for their own events, and after dinner they horsed around noisily until lights-out.{p}

I wonder how much time passed. One girl was woken by the sound of a cat.
"Whose cat is that? It's so noisy."
She looked around, but there was no cat.
"A cat, in a place like this...... Ah!"
She remembered.
What they had done here, a few months before.{p}

Then, when she happened to glance away, there was a cat, standing perfectly still.
"Eeeek!"
She screamed before she could stop herself.
Several people woke up at the scream.{p}

"What's wrong...?"
A few people gathered around her.
"Th-the cat..."
"What about the cat?"
As she looked at them, all clearly annoyed, she got a bad feeling.
Because the ones gathered there were the very girls who had killed the cat back then.
"Everyone, be careful."
"Huh...?"
They all looked at one another.
And then they remembered.
What they had done.
And just then...

When they turned around, the cat was there.
The cat was staring right at them.
And they couldn't take their eyes off the cat either.
Then something began to rise up behind the cat.
"Wh-what is that..."
When someone finally managed to speak, they all slowly raised their eyes.{p}

"N-Naoko..."
Takeda was there, behind the cat.

"Heh heh heh heh..."
She laughed eerily.{p}

The next day, the bullies had vanished.
And strangely enough, there were exactly as many cats as there were missing girls.
The police searched for them, but they were never found.
In the end, it was decided they had run away from home.
Hm? The cats from that night, you mean?
They did nothing but cry, and people found them creepy, so no one would take them.
So they were taken to the pound.
I heard this later, but apparently those cats were handed over to a university hospital and became lab animals.
Do you know what they do to lab animals?
They make them sick on purpose, and dissect them without anesthesia.
Because, supposedly, with anesthesia they can't get accurate data.
What? You don't think that's disgusting?
{a}, go look into it yourself. Lab animals.
If you go to the library, you'll find out.
It's beyond anything you can imagine.
And what's more, those lab animals used to be human..................
That's what I think, anyway.
Because they appear, you see. In the lodge...
The ghosts of those girls, with their bellies ripped open, or turned into specimens.
When I heard that story, I quit the soccer team.
I don't want to stay overnight in that lodge.
If you think it's just a rumor, why don't you try staying there yourself?
Still, I think that's the reason so many people quit the sports teams after summer vacation.
Well, anyway, I'll end my story here.
I'd rather not picture it too much.
Next, please.{p}

Yes, they used it as ammunition to corner her, and bullied her all over again.
"Naoko, do you think it's okay to keep a cat at school?"
"If we tell a teacher, that cat's going straight to the pound."
"Don't just stand there saying nothing. Hurry up and go dump it."
She just let them say whatever they liked and do whatever they liked to her.
Then they went and got the kitten, threw it at Takeda,
"Guess you'll just have to dump it at the garbage heap or something."
and walked off, saying that.{p}

Takeda wandered the streets at night, holding the kitten.
"I'm sorry. There's nothing I can do..."
Unable to find any way out, she finally jumped off a pedestrian bridge with the cat in her arms.

"Let's die together..."
She was hit by a truck.{p}

The next day, the bullies said,
"This stays absolutely secret, got it?"
"I know."
"She didn't have to die over a stupid cat."
"Yeah. She should've just found someone to take it."
And like that, they kept quiet about it.{p}

A few days went by.
Just as they were starting to forget the incident, they were walking home from school together.
"Hey, a cat."
"It's kind of staring at us."
The girls remembered the incident they had pushed into a corner of their minds.
"This is kind of creepy."
"Let's go."
"Yeah."
All of them turned back the way they had come.
When they had gone back a few steps, a cat let out a furious yowl behind them.{p}

When they turned around, there was the cat Takeda had been carrying that night.
"What? Isn't that the cat Naoko had with her?"
"It's creepy. Let's just go."
And just as they turned back around...{p}

"Eeek!"
Takeda was standing behind them.
"N-Naoko......."
And behind her were countless cats.
"Hey, everyone, won't you take these cats in?"
Saying that, she slowly came closer.
"S-stop it."
Before they knew it, they were surrounded by countless cats.
"Come on, take them."{p}So, what do you think they answered?
We'll take them
We don't want to take them

"Fine, we'll take them.
That's what you want, right?"
That's what they answered.
"Thank you..."{p}

When Takeda had answered, she suddenly vanished, cats and all.
And there, a few cats had been left behind.
"C-cats..."
"Wh-what do we do?"
"But if we don't keep our promise......."
Each of them took one cat home.{p}

For a while, partly out of fear, they took good care of them.
Then one day, one of the girls had a favorite outfit of hers torn up by her cat.
She took the cat outside and roughly dumped it.
"Stupid cat, who needs you?"{p}
And on her way back, she was run over by a truck.

It crushed her head under its wheels, too.
They say the cat she had dumped came to the spot and lapped away at her brains, lick, lick.{p}

When they heard about it, the rest of them could feel death closing in on them too.
Especially the girl who had already thrown her cat out of the house.
"If she had dumped her cat sooner, I would never have thrown mine out...
Even back then, I wasn't the one bullying Takeda.
Th-then why is this happening to me?
That's right, the one who should die is her, the one who led it all."
She sat huddled in a corner of her room, hugging her knees and shaking all over.
Then she abruptly stood up, made a phone call, and left the house.{p}

She went to the park.
The friend she had called out a little earlier was waiting for her there.
She slowly circled around behind her friend, lifted a rock, and brought it down on her friend's head.{p}

"If you die, I'll be saved..."
As she stood there, cats gathered from out of nowhere.
And they began licking the blood of the girl lying on the ground.
She watched blankly for a while, but as her terror mounted, she tried to slip away.{p}
